data.name: Pad_SteeringAngleRumble_Description

Xa kukhethwe "Yahlula ngokwecala", intshukumo eya ngasekhohlo iqhuba imoto yasekhohlo, eya ngasekunene iqhuba eyasekunene. "Imoto yasekhohlo" okanye "Imoto yasekunene" ibeka omabini amacala kuloo moto inye. Isetyenziselwa isiphumo se-Xbox nese-PlayStation kunye nezixhobo ezingcangcazelayo. Itsiba amavili, ezinye izixhobo ezine-force feedback eqhubekayo, kunye neepedali ze-Fanatec.
